song.title: Should I Stay Or Should I Go

guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Junior (Mick Jones) / Fender Telecaster (Joe Strummer)
guitar.notes: Mick Jones's white Gibson Les Paul Junior (seen on the London Calling cover, smashed by Paul Simonon) and Strummer's black Telecaster are iconic and extensively documented punk imagery.

tone.target: bright Vox-style crunch with tight punk rhythm
tone.profile: bright Vox-style crunch with tight punk rhythm
tone.summary: A punchy, bright signal chain using a Green OD boost for initial grit, followed by the AC30 TB amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab, keeping effects minimal to maintain tightness and dryness.

rig.name: The Clash - Should I Stay Or Should I Go - Valeton GP-180
